blocks.title: Soil texture needs checking
blocks.body: Map estimates cannot replace a soil test. Add your own test if you have one.

screens.title: What can your farm rely on?
screens.subtitle: A few details help us show plans you can carry out.

blocks.body: A field test takes priority over map estimates.

screens.title: Who and what can help?
screens.subtitle: You can choose “I don't know” and fill this in later.

blocks.body: If irrigated, we also ask how reliable the water supply is. Unknown answers remain visible on each plan.

blocks.label: Money needed before first sale
blocks.body: For your 2.0 ha plot · example budget

blocks.title: First action: confirm the sowing window
blocks.body: Rainfall, seed availability and contractor dates need local confirmation. First expected sale: Jul 2027.

blocks.title: Why consider this plan?
blocks.body: Benefit: a cereal followed by a legume adds variety. Trade-off: you need to fund the first season and arrange machinery.

screens.title: From first sowing to sale
screens.subtitle: Wheat → Chickpea · approximate pilot dates

blocks.body: Plant only when local rain and field conditions allow. Book labor and machinery before the work window.

screens.title: Can you fund the plan?
screens.subtitle: Example cash flow · whole plot · 2.0 ha

blocks.label: Before the first sale · Jul 2027
blocks.body: Available: 14,000 DH · 2,000 DH buffer

blocks.title: Peak opening cash: 12,000 DH
blocks.body: The largest shortfall across the entire plan is also before the first sale. Wheat receipts in Jul 2027 help pay the next season.
Setup counted once. Receipts follow payment dates, not harvest dates. All amounts are editable examples.

screens.title: What might be left?
screens.subtitle: Illustrative figures · 2 seasons · 2.0 ha

blocks.body: Per hectare: 15,000 DH revenue; 5,000 DH margin; 4,500 DH after setup. Family labor value is shown separately.

blocks.label: Review yield, price and break-even inputs

screens.title: Review assumptions
screens.subtitle: Try a different budget. Price, yield, machinery and dates are read-only sample baselines.

blocks.body: Example wheat break-even revenue: 11,000 DH for 2 ha; at 2.5 t/ha, break-even price is 2,200 DH/t. Only available cash can change here. Applying your budget updates the cash gap in comparison and chat; other example inputs stay fixed.

screens.title: You would need 2,000 DH more
screens.subtitle: Preview · your saved assumptions have not changed.

blocks.label: Gap before the first sale
blocks.body: 12,000 DH needed − 10,000 DH available

blocks.title: What changed?
blocks.body: You reduced available cash from 14,000 to 10,000 DH. Costs and expected receipts stayed the same. Cash after setup remains 9,000 DH in the typical example.

blocks.title: A lower-cash alternative
blocks.body: Barley → Chickpea needs 10,000 DH before sales in this example. It also has a lower expected margin.
Applying this change updates the plan, comparison and Ask AgriX context together.

screens.title: Check the sale-price assumption
screens.subtitle: Wheat · Settat pilot · DH per tonne

blocks.title: Verified local price history unavailable
blocks.body: We have not verified historical farm-gate observations for this pilot. No historical chart is shown until a source and date range are available.

blocks.label: Future selling price · assumption
blocks.body: Read-only sample baseline, separate from historical prices.
When available: show dated price observations, source, units and a one-sentence explanation. Never treat a historic price as a future promise.

screens.title: Find the people you need
screens.subtitle: Seed, machinery, transport and sales

blocks.title: Start with a local cooperative
blocks.body: Ask about certified seed, harvest contractors and buyers. Confirm what is available for your dates.

blocks.title: Before you accept a quote
blocks.body: Ask for price and unit, service area, operator inclusion, travel charges, work date and payment terms.
No supplier names or contacts have been verified for this pilot. Future listings include location, public contact and date checked.

screens.title: Book the work before you sow
screens.subtitle: First wheat season · example needs · whole plot · 2.0 ha

blocks.title: Machinery · hire with an operator
blocks.body:
Land preparation + sowing + harvest
3,000 DH / plot · 1,500 DH / ha
Operator included. Confirm dates and quote.

blocks.title: People · plan the busy weeks
blocks.body:
Paid: 8 person-days × 250 DH = 2,000 DH
Family: 4 person-days · shown separately
Peak: sowing and harvest weeks. Workers not yet arranged.

blocks.title: Value family time separately
blocks.body: At 250 DH/day, family time is 1,000 DH. It is not a cash payment in this budget.
Buying comparison unavailable until a verified purchase price and expected use are entered. Do not count the operator twice.

screens.title: Ask AgriX
screens.subtitle: Your plot and current plan stay in the conversation.

blocks.body: Settat · 2.0 ha · Wheat → Chickpea · typical example
شحال خاصني قبل أول بيعة؟
فهاد المثال، خاصك 12,000 درهم قبل أول بيعة. هاد المبلغ للأرض كاملة، وكيجمع التحضير والزريعة والخدمة والنقل. خاصك تأكد الأثمنة والتواريخ محلياً.
To change an assumption, AgriX shows a preview and asks you to confirm before saving.

screens.title: Two edges cross
screens.subtitle: Move a corner so the boundary follows your plot.

blocks.title: Your outline needs one correction
blocks.body: Drag the highlighted point, undo the last point, or redraw. The rest of your work is kept.

screens.title: Some results are ready
screens.subtitle: The selected plot is kept while a source is unavailable.

blocks.title: A missing source is different from an unknown input
blocks.body: Retry soil moisture when the service returns. A field soil test can be added whenever you have one.
Continue with available evidence. Conclusions that depend on missing information remain pending.

screens.title: Where the information comes from
screens.subtitle: Estimates, measurements and your answers are labeled.

blocks.title: A grid may be larger than your plot
blocks.body: Regional values describe the surrounding area. They are not a measurement taken in your field.
Pilot has no retrieved observations attached. Each live layer must show its date or period, resolution, units, source and limitations.

screens.title: One answer before we can check
screens.subtitle: Your custom draft is kept.

blocks.label: Needs confirmation
blocks.value: Was the previous crop a legume?
blocks.body: The sequence check depends on what grew here before.
The timeline is visible. Feasibility and any affected estimates remain pending until the missing input is resolved.

screens.title: This crop needs a different setup
screens.subtitle: Doesn't fit the current rainfed pilot conditions

blocks.label: Season 2 · irrigated crop example
blocks.body: Reliable irrigation is required by this catalog entry, but the plot is marked rainfed.

blocks.title: Try a supported rainfed crop
blocks.body: Replace the conflicting crop, adjust the window where allowed, or correct your water-access information. Recheck the whole rotation.
Your draft stays available. A conflicting crop cannot open a feasible-plan report.

screens.title: No plan fits those inputs yet
screens.subtitle: Your plot and answers are kept.

blocks.label: Cash constraint · example
blocks.body: Every current pilot option needs more cash before its first sale.

blocks.title: What could change?
blocks.body: Review available cash, update local hiring costs, or build another supported sequence. We will explain which requirement changes.
No suitable option is a result too. AgriX does not hide constraints to show a recommendation.

screens.title: Your progress is still here
screens.subtitle: The connection was interrupted.

blocks.title: Plot and draft kept
blocks.body: We will retry the missing information when you reconnect. Available results remain visible, with their date and status.

blocks.title: If you change the boundary
blocks.body: Soil and climate analysis, feasibility, costs, comparison and chat context must refresh for the new plot.
